questions.q: What age does Pink say we are moving into?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says we are moving from the Information Age into the Conceptual Age.

questions.q: Which of these is one of the six senses of right-brain thinking?
questions.why: Lesson 1 lists design, story, symphony, empathy, play and meaning.

questions.q: Why isn't knowing facts enough anymore, per lesson 2?
questions.why: Lesson 2 says facts are easy to find, so stories now persuade.

questions.q: What example does the summary give of selling a 'why'?
questions.why: Lesson 2 says advertising and consulting sell a why.

questions.q: What skill gives humans an edge over AI, per lesson 3?
questions.why: Lesson 3 says emotional skills like empathy matter because machines can't replicate them.
